name: John Fitch
features: fair skin, sandy hair combed back, light eyes, long angular face, strong chin, lean athletic build, thoughtful engineer’s expression
bio: A wartime Mustang pilot who became the first American to make a real career of racing in post-war Europe, winning Sebring in 1953, the production class of the 1955 Mille Miglia and the Tourist Trophy the same year for Mercedes. After Le Mans in 1955, where his co-driver Pierre Levegh died, he turned to safety engineering: the sand-filled Fitch barrier on American highway ramps is his, and is reckoned to have saved some seventeen thousand lives.
